farm: Jiangsu Jiangjiasha H1 Offshore wind farm · 1
proposal: fix('CHN', 'Jiangsu Jiangjiasha H1 Offshore wind farm · 1', G, '龍源海安蔣家沙 300 MW（2018 年建成，75 部遠景 4 MW；世紀新能源網 2025）：江蘇海事局 2022 年航行通告寫 67 號風機中心座標 32°39.011′N、121°07.280′E；座標改到這部風機（概略位置，風場範圍在其周圍），原點 31.773 N、121.105 E 在長江口，偏南約 100 km', 'Longyuan’s Hai’an Jiangjiasha 300 MW farm (built 2018, 75 Envision 4 MW turbines; ne21 2025): a 2022 Jiangsu MSA notice gives the centre of turbine 67 as 32°39.011′N, 121°07.280′E; point moved to that turbine (approximate, the farm lies around it); the old point, 31.773 N 121.105 E, was in the Yangtze estuary about 100 km to the south', 'https://www.js.msa.gov.cn/art/2022/5/27/art_75_1350583.html', lat=32.650, lon=121.121, approx=True, turbine='75x Envision 4 MW')
note_zh: 江蘇海事局通航通〔2022〕0103 號：「龍源海安蔣家沙 300MW 海上風電場遠景能源 67# 齒輪箱更換」，以 67 號風機中心座標 32°39.011′N／121°07.280′E 為圓心 400 m（建設單位江蘇海上龍源）。換算 32.650 N、121.121 E，是一部風機的官方座標，故標概略位置。機組：世紀新能源網（2025，轉龍源／遠景）寫 2018 年建成、75 台遠景 4 MW；原機型欄空白（屬建成值）。
note_en: Jiangsu MSA notice 2022-0103: gearbox replacement on Envision turbine 67 of Longyuan’s Hai’an Jiangjiasha 300 MW farm, works circle of 400 m around the turbine centre 32°39.011′N / 121°07.280′E (developer Jiangsu Offshore Longyuan). That is 32.650 N, 121.121 E: an official position of one turbine, so marked approximate. Turbines: ne21 (2025) says the farm was built in 2018 with 75 Envision 4 MW units (as-built); the turbine field was empty.
why: No sea-use corner points found (tzw.nantong.gov.cn reset; msa.gov.cn article.do pages 403). One turbine position is the best official point found.

farm: Jiangsu Jiangjiasha H2 Offshore wind farm
proposal: fix('CHN', 'Jiangsu Jiangjiasha H2 Offshore wind farm', G, '江蘇海事局 2022 年航行通告：蔣家沙（H2#）300MW 海上風電場 43 號風機座標 32°44′30.44″N、121°14′12.96″E（建設單位九思海上風力發電如東）；同年另一通告的維護作業水域（11 點連線）也在北緯 32.68–32.78°。座標改到 43 號風機（概略位置），原點 31.773 N、121.105 E 在長江口，偏南約 110 km', 'Jiangsu MSA notices (2022): turbine 43 of the Jiangjiasha (H2#) 300 MW farm stands at 32°44′30.44″N, 121°14′12.96″E (developer Jiusi Offshore Wind Rudong); another notice’s maintenance area (11 points) also lies at 32.68–32.78° N. Point moved to turbine 43 (approximate); the old point, 31.773 N 121.105 E, was in the Yangtze estuary about 110 km to the south', 'https://js.msa.gov.cn/art/2022/4/18/art_280_1339155.html', lat=32.742, lon=121.237, approx=True)
note_zh: 江蘇海事局通航通〔2022〕0058 號：蔣家沙（H2#）300MW 風場 43 號風機葉片更換，以風機座標點 32°44′30.443866″N／121°14′12.963848″E 為中心（建設單位九思海上風力發電如東有限公司）；換算 32.742 N、121.237 E。通航通〔2022〕0077 號（同風場 14 台風機基礎防護）的施工水域為 11 點連線，緯度 32°40′36″–32°46′40″N、經度 120°59′09″–121°16′13″E，與 43 號風機位置一致。機型仍查不到建成值（2020 年規劃 67 台 4.5 MW，見 cn_vn_step5e）。
note_en: Jiangsu MSA notice 2022-0058: blade replacement on turbine 43 of the Jiangjiasha (H2#) 300 MW farm, centred on 32°44′30.443866″N / 121°14′12.963848″E (developer Jiusi Offshore Wind Power Rudong); i.e. 32.742 N, 121.237 E. Notice 2022-0077 (scour protection on 14 of the farm’s turbines) defines its works area by 11 points between 32°40′36″ and 32°46′40″ N and 120°59′09″–121°16′13″ E, consistent with turbine 43. As-built turbine model still not found (2020 plan: 67 × 4.5 MW).
why: Sea-use approval not found; turbine position from MSA notices is the best official point.

farm: Guoxin Dafeng 850 MW
proposal: fix('CHN', 'Guoxin Dafeng 850 MW', C, '國信大豐 85 萬千瓦：四個場址（H1#、H2#、H10#、H16#）共 100 部 8.5 MW，2025 年 12 月 29 日全容量併網（中國能建，2026-01；人民日報 2026-01-06）；2024 年 6 月風機標由金風科技預中標。原寫「明陽／金風 10–16 MW」', 'Guoxin Dafeng 850 MW: four sites (H1#, H2#, H10#, H16#) with 100 × 8.5 MW turbines, fully connected on 29 Dec 2025 (China Energy Engineering, Jan 2026; People’s Daily, 6 Jan 2026); Goldwind was the preferred bidder for the turbines in June 2024. Was “Mingyang/Goldwind 10–16 MW”', 'https://www.ceec.net.cn/art/2026/1/6/art_11019_2537923.html', turbine='100x Goldwind 8.5 MW')
note_zh: 狀態、年份無誤：2025-06-26 首批併網、2025-12-29 全容量併網（中國能建江蘇院）。機組：人民日報寫共安裝 100 台 8.5 MW（建成值）；廠牌依 2024-06 中標候選人公示（金風科技預中標，中電協），沒有矛盾出處，屬得標資料。注意招標文件原寫 99 台 8.5 MW＋1 台 13 MW 以上試驗機，完工報導是 100 台 8.5 MW，以完工報導為準。業主自稱「8.5MW 機型批量化應用」與此一致。
note_en: Status and year are right: first units on 26 Jun 2025, full connection on 29 Dec 2025 (CEEC Jiangsu Institute). Turbines: People’s Daily says 100 × 8.5 MW were installed (as built); the make comes from the June 2024 preferred-bidder notice (Goldwind, via CEEIA), uncontradicted, so it is an award. The tender had asked for 99 × 8.5 MW plus one 13 MW+ test unit; the completion reports say 100 × 8.5 MW, which is used.

item: 4. SPIC Binhai South H3 full-connection year
farm: SPIC Binhai South H3
proposal: fix('CHN', 'SPIC Binhai South H3', C, '國家電投濱海南 H3（300 MW）2020 年 12 月 31 日全容量併網，裝 75 台上海電氣 W4000-146（電氣風電，2024）；原寫 2019 年，業主欄誤為大唐／國信（來自被自動併入的大唐濱海紀錄）', 'SPIC Binhai South H3 (300 MW) reached full grid connection on 31 Dec 2020 with 75 Shanghai Electric W4000-146 turbines (Shanghai Electric Wind Power, 2024); the row said 2019 and its owner field was Datang/Guoxin (taken from the Datang Binhai record merged into it by the build)', 'http://windpower.cpem.org.cn/contents/31/1370.html', year=2020, turbine='75x Shanghai Electric W4000-146', owner='SPIC Jiangsu Electric Power Co Ltd')
note_zh: 濱海南 H3：2019-12-28 海上主體開工、2020 年底全容量投產（國家電投江蘇海上風電公司，CPEM 2021）；電氣風電 2024：2020-12-31 全容量併網、75 台 W4000-146。年份改 2020。另發現：建置把 GEM「Jiangsu Binhai (Datang) Offshore wind farm」（大唐國信濱海 302 MW，2019-12-25 全部風機併網，另一座風場）當成這筆的重複自動併掉，大唐濱海因此從資料消失、業主欄也被帶過來；建議把它列進 GEM_KEEP（見下一筆）。
note_en: Binhai South H3: offshore works started 28 Dec 2019 and the farm was fully in service at the end of 2020 (SPIC Jiangsu Offshore Wind, CPEM 2021); Shanghai Electric Wind Power (2024): full connection on 31 Dec 2020, 75 × W4000-146. Year to 2020. Also found: the build auto-merged GEM’s “Jiangsu Binhai (Datang) Offshore wind farm” (Datang-Guoxin Binhai 302 MW, all turbines connected 25 Dec 2019, a different farm) into this record, so the Datang farm vanished and its owner was copied here; add it to GEM_KEEP (next entry).

sources.quote: 该项目于2020年12月31日实现全容量并网，电气风电提供75台单机容量4.0MW的W4000-146型风电机组，总装机规模300MW。
2018年12月，盐城滨海南H3（30万千瓦）取得核准，2019年12月28日，项目海上主体工程采用施工总承包的方式开工建设，2020年12月底建成投产。

item: 4. Datang Binhai (GEM) wrongly merged into Binhai South H3
farm: Jiangsu Binhai (Datang) Offshore wind farm (merged away by the build)
proposal: GEM_KEEP: ('CHN', 'Jiangsu Binhai (Datang) Offshore wind farm'): ('大唐國信濱海 300 MW 海上風電（廢黃河口至扁擔港之間，3 MW 與 3.3 MW 機組）2019 年 12 月 25 日全部風機併網，是與國家電投濱海南 H3（2020 年底投產）不同的風場；舊建置因名稱都有「濱海」而把它併進濱海南 H3，整座消失', 'Datang-Guoxin’s Binhai 300 MW offshore farm (3 MW and 3.3 MW turbines) had all turbines connected on 25 Dec 2019; it is not SPIC’s Binhai South H3 (in service end-2020), into which the build merged it because both names contain “Binhai”, so the farm vanished', 'https://www.ne21.com/news/show-132982.html')

item: 5. GEM Shandong Bohai B1 (500 MW) capacity/status
farm: Shandong Bohai B1 offshore wind farm
proposal: fix('CHN', 'Shandong Bohai B1 offshore wind farm', G, '渤中 B 場址規劃 1,000 MW，山東能源負責西側 500 MW：其中 400 MW（47 部 8.5 MW）2022 年底已建成，是精選紀錄「Shandong Energy Bozhong B」；剩下的 100 MW 才是「渤中海上風電基地 B1 項目」（8 部 8.5 MW＋4 部 8 MW，接入已建的 B 場址升壓站），2024 年 10 月招標、2025 年 6 月國資委仍寫「正在建設、將於近期併網」。GEM 的 500 MW 把已建的 400 MW 重算一次，改為 100 MW 的續建案，維持興建中', 'Bozhong site B is planned at 1,000 MW, with Shandong Energy developing the western 500 MW: 400 MW of it (47 × 8.5 MW) was built by end-2022 and is the curated record “Shandong Energy Bozhong B”; only the remaining 100 MW is the “Bozhong offshore wind base B1 project” (8 × 8.5 MW + 4 × 8 MW, connected to the existing site-B substation), tendered in Oct 2024 and still “under construction, to be connected soon” per SASAC in June 2025. GEM’s 500 MW counts the built 400 MW again; reduced to the 100 MW extension, kept under construction', 'https://www.ne21.com/news/show-202646.html', rename='Shandong Energy Bozhong B1 (100 MW extension)', zhname='山東能源渤中B1（續建10萬千瓦）', mw=100, turbine='8x 8.5 MW + 4x 8 MW')
note_zh: 中國電建 2024-10-22 競談公告（世紀新能源網轉）：B 場址規劃 1000 MW，山東能源負責西側 500 MW，前期已完成 400 MW，本次建設剩餘 100 MW，命名為 B1 項目，8×8.5 MW＋4×8.0 MW。大眾日報 2024-08：「B1 場址續建 10 萬千瓦項目」正在建設；國資委（2025-06 以後）：「正在建設的渤中海上風電 B1 場址 10 萬千瓦風電場將於近期併網」。2026-10 仍查不到全容量併網的報導，故維持興建中（機組依招標，標為計畫值）。附註：東營市政府 2024-11 稱「A、B1、B2 三個場址已建成，規模 140.2 萬千瓦」（50.1＋39.95＋50.15），即「B1 場址」也被用來指已建的 399.5 MW，名稱容易混淆。
note_en: PowerChina negotiation notice of 22 Oct 2024 (via ne21): site B is planned at 1,000 MW, Shandong Energy develops the western 500 MW, 400 MW is already built, and the remaining 100 MW is the “B1 project”, 8 × 8.5 MW + 4 × 8.0 MW. Dazhong Daily (Aug 2024): the “B1 site continuation 100 MW” was under construction; SASAC (after June 2025): “the B1 site 100 MW farm under construction will be connected soon”. No full-connection report found as of Oct 2026, so kept under construction (turbines per tender). Note: Dongying (Nov 2024) calls the built sites “A, B1, B2… 1,402 MW” (50.1 + 39.95 + 50.15), so “B1 site” is also used for the built 399.5 MW.

item: 7. Peninsula South U2 (Guohua) status and phases
farm: Shandong Bandaonan U2 (Guohua) Offshore wind farm
proposal: (lead) if accepted: fix('CHN', 'Shandong Bandaonan U2 (Guohua) Offshore wind farm', G, …, 'https://www.ceic.com/gjnyjtww/chnjcxw/202509/92abff82688f4920bbcb5f96176c7f2b.shtml', st=0, year=2024, turbine='71x Envision EN226-8.5')
note_zh: U2 是國家能源集團國華投資的場址（不是國家電投）：603.5 MW、71 部遠景 EN226-8.5 MW，一期 306 MW（36 部）、二期 297.5 MW（35 部）。正反證據：(1) 2024-10-26 國家電投 U1 二期併網時，中國電器工業協會等寫「山東半島南 U 場址海上風電項目（150 萬千瓦，含 U2 60 萬千瓦）實現全容量併網」；(2) 國家能源集團 2025-09-02：U2 60 萬千瓦「安裝 71 台」、2025-08-28 全容量登記 CCER；但 (3) 中證鵬元 2025-06 評級報告把 U2 一期、二期都列在「截至 2024 年末公司主要在建、擬建項目」（2025 年各只剩 0.74、0.63 億元投資）；(4) 山東 2025 年海洋強省重點項目名單仍有 U2 二期。查不到 U2 自己的全容量併網日期，維持線索；若主對話接受 U 場址整體併網的說法，可改營運中 2024 年。
note_en: U2 is CHN Energy Guohua’s site (not SPIC): 603.5 MW, 71 Envision EN226-8.5 MW, phase 1 306 MW (36 units), phase 2 297.5 MW (35). For: (1) when SPIC’s U1 phase 2 connected on 26 Oct 2024, CEEIA and others wrote that “the Peninsula South U-site project (1,500 MW incl. U2’s 600 MW) reached full capacity”; (2) CHN Energy, 2 Sept 2025: U2 600 MW “has 71 turbines installed” and was registered for its full capacity under CCER on 28 Aug 2025. Against: (3) the June 2025 CSCI Pengyuan rating report lists U2 phases 1 and 2 among the company’s “projects under construction or planned at end-2024” (only CNY 74 m and 63 m left for 2025); (4) Shandong’s 2025 marine key-project list still includes U2 phase 2. No U2-specific full-connection date found, so a lead; if the main session accepts the U-site statement, set operating 2024.
why: No U2-specific grid-connection report; ceic/cpnn give only CCER registration; carbontree.com.cn (U2 phase-1 emission-reduction notice) fails TLS verification; cpnn.com.cn connection drops.

proposal: fix('CHN', 'Zhuhai Guishan', C, '桂山海上風電場總裝機 198 MW，2021 年 12 月才全容量併網（廣州發展新能源，2023）；一期 120 MW 為 34 部 3 MW 加 3 部 6 MW，「一期後續及二期」2020 年底才開工、2021 年 2 月首台併網。原寫 2018 年（只是首批風機併網）', 'Guishan totals 198 MW and only reached full grid connection in Dec 2021 (Guangzhou Development New Energy, 2023); phase 1 (120 MW) is 34 × 3 MW plus 3 × 6 MW, and the “phase-1 follow-up and phase 2” works began in late 2020, with their first unit connected in Feb 2021. The row said 2018 (when the first turbines connected)', 'https://www.ne21.com/news/show-178370.html', year=2021)
note_zh: 年份可寫：198 MW 2021 年 12 月全容量併網（股東廣州發展新能源，世紀新能源網 2023）。分期可選擇加 ph=[[2019, 120], [2021, 78]]（廣東小康工程資料庫：一期 120 MW、2019 年 12 月投產；南方日報 2021-04：二期 78 MW、2021 年底前建成），但「一期後續」（一期裡的 3 部 6 MW）是 2020 年底才和二期一起施工，2019 年的 120 MW 未必都已運轉，主對話自行決定。機型欄仍是線索：「15x 5.5 MW」沒有出處；一期為 34×3 MW＋3×6 MW；二期 15 部，其中 3 部為測試樣機，有明陽 6.45 MW；國際風力發電網（403 擋）的「一期後續及二期 88.25 MW、1 部 8.3 MW＋8 部 7 MW＋4 部 6.45 MW、共 13 部，12 月 8 日全容量併網」只見於搜尋摘要，數字也加不起來（90.1 MW），不採用。維基百科另稱 2024 年在二期範圍加建兩部（海事局 2024 筒型基礎專項通告，403），總部數待查證。
note_en: Year can be written: 198 MW fully connected in Dec 2021 (shareholder Guangzhou Development New Energy, ne21 2023). Phases optional: ph=[[2019, 120], [2021, 78]] (Guangdong key-project record: phase 1 120 MW in service Dec 2019; Southern Daily Apr 2021: phase 2 78 MW to be finished by end-2021), but the “phase-1 follow-up” (the 3 × 6 MW of phase 1) was built with phase 2 from late 2020, so not all 120 MW was necessarily running in 2019 — main session to decide. Turbine field stays a lead: “15x 5.5 MW” has no source; phase 1 is 34 × 3 MW + 3 × 6 MW; phase 2 has 15 units incl. 3 test units and Mingyang 6.45 MW machines; the in-en report (403) of “follow-up + phase 2 = 88.25 MW, 1 × 8.3 + 8 × 7 + 4 × 6.45 MW, 13 units, full connection on 8 Dec” is only a search snippet and does not add up (90.1 MW), so not used. Wikipedia says two more units were added in phase 2 in 2024 (MSA bucket-foundation notice, 403); total unit count unverified.
why: in-en.com 403 and fengdianzhijia.com reset (full-connection report with the 13-unit list); msa.gov.cn article.do 403 (2024 bucket-foundation works).

proposal: see the 12a–12c entries and items 3, 4, 5, 8, 10
note_zh: 以目前的 wind_farms.json 重算：中國營運中離岸（含浮動式）140 筆、47,189 MW，其中年份 ≤2025 的 44,669 MW；國家數列 2025 年 48,400 MW。TODO 寫的 58.9 GW 是舊建置的數字（之後的清理規則已刪掉多筆彙總與重複），現在逐場加總反而低於國家數列約 3.7 GW。仍會高估的：12a「舟山六橫／浙江其他」600 MW 彙總（與普陀 6 號 2 區、嘉興 2 號重複）、12b 華能玉環 2 號 504 MW（2025 年 4 月才陸上倒送電，卻列 2024 年營運中）；興建中裡的重複：國信大豐 GEM 四筆 850 MW（第 3 項）、GEM 渤中 B1 500 MW 重算已建的 400 MW（第 5 項）。少算的：大唐濱海 302 MW 被建置誤併掉（第 4 項）。年份要往前或往後移的：徐聞原場 2022→2021、濱海南 H3 2019→2020、桂山 2018→2021、防城港 A 2024→2025（12c）。其餘查過、無誤的大型紀錄：三峽大豐 800 MW（2025-12-15 全容量併網）、三峽陽江青洲六（廣州日報：2024-12-26 第 15 回集電線路併網、列為 2024 年已投運；「12-27 全容量併網」只見於搜尋摘要）、三峽漳浦六鰲二期（2024-06-27，搜尋所得，未另引原文）、國信大豐（2025-12-29）。
note_en: Recomputed from the current wind_farms.json: 140 operating Chinese offshore records (incl. floating), 47,189 MW, of which 44,669 MW have year ≤ 2025; the national 2025 figure is 48,400 MW. The 58.9 GW in TODO is from an older build (later cleanup rules removed several aggregates and duplicates); the per-farm sum is now about 3.7 GW below the national series. Still overcounting: 12a the 600 MW “Zhoushan Liuheng / Zhejiang others” aggregate (duplicates Putuo 6 zone 2 and Jiaxing 2) and 12b Huaneng Yuhuan 2 (504 MW, listed operating in 2024 although only back-energised onshore in April 2025). Duplicates among records under construction: GEM’s four Guoxin Dafeng sites, 850 MW (item 3), and GEM Bohai B1 500 MW recounting the built 400 MW (item 5). Undercount: Datang Binhai 302 MW wrongly merged away by the build (item 4). Year shifts: Xuwen original farm 2022→2021, Binhai South H3 2019→2020, Guishan 2018→2021, Fangchenggang A 2024→2025 (12c). Large records checked and found right: CTG Dafeng 800 MW (full 15 Dec 2025), CTG Yangjiang Qingzhou 6 (Guangzhou Daily: collector line 15 connected on 26 Dec 2024 and the farm counted among 2024’s commissioned projects; “full connection 27 Dec 2024” seen only in a search snippet), CTG Zhangpu Liu’ao II (27 Jun 2024, from search, not quoted), Guoxin Dafeng (29 Dec 2025).
why: Not exhaustive: CR Power Lianjiang Waihai (700 MW, 2025), Shanghai Jinshan (306 MW, 2025) and Zhuanghe V (250 MW, 2025) were not re-checked (no completion report found in a quick search for Lianjiang).

item: 12a. Aggregate “Zhoushan Liuheng / Zhejiang others” duplicates two farms
farm: Zhoushan Liuheng / Zhejiang others
proposal: drop('CHN', 'Zhoushan Liuheng / Zhejiang others', C, '「舟山六橫、嘉興 2 號等」600 MW 是彙總：六橫島東南外海的風場就是國電舟山普陀 6 號 2 區（252 MW，已有精選紀錄），嘉興 2 號（華能 300 MW）也已有 GEM 紀錄，這筆把兩座再算一次', 'The 600 MW “Zhoushan Liuheng, Jiaxing 2 etc.” row is an aggregate: the farm off Liuheng island is Guodian’s Zhoushan Putuo 6 zone 2 (252 MW, already a curated record) and Jiaxing 2 (Huaneng, 300 MW) already has a GEM record, so this row counts both again', 'https://zsxq.zjol.com.cn/hyjjxw/tpxw/201903/t20190330_9793315.shtml')
note_zh: 這筆精選紀錄 600 MW、2022、機型「mixed」、中文名「舟山六橫、嘉興 2 號等」。浙江在線 2019：國電舟山普陀 6 號海上風電場位於六橫島東南側、25.2 萬千瓦；舟山發布 2017：位於舟山六橫島海域的全省首個海上風電項目即普陀 6 號 2 區。資料裡已有「Guodian Zhoushan Putuo 6#2」（252 MW，2019）與 GEM「Zhejiang Jiaxing 2 Offshore wind farm」（300 MW，2021）。build_farms.log 沒有 GEM 專案併進這筆，刪除不會留下孤兒。刪除後營運中減少 600 MW。
note_en: Curated record: 600 MW, 2022, turbines “mixed”, Chinese name “Zhoushan Liuheng, Jiaxing 2 etc.”. Zhejiang Online (2019): Guodian’s Zhoushan Putuo 6 offshore farm lies south-east of Liuheng island, 252 MW; Zhoushan Release (2017): the province’s first offshore farm, off Liuheng island, is Putuo 6 zone 2. The data already have “Guodian Zhoushan Putuo 6#2” (252 MW, 2019) and GEM’s “Zhejiang Jiaxing 2 Offshore wind farm” (300 MW, 2021). build_farms.log shows no GEM project merged into this row, so dropping it leaves no orphan. Removes 600 MW of operating capacity.

item: 12b. Huaneng Yuhuan 2 listed operating 2024 but not on the grid in April 2025
farm: Huaneng Yuhuan 2
proposal: (lead) at least the year 2024 is wrong; e.g. fix('CHN', 'Huadian Yuhuan 2', C, '玉環 2 號 2025 年 4 月才完成陸上倒送電、尚未併網，不是 2024 年營運中；改為興建中，查到全容量併網再改回', 'Yuhuan 2 was only back-energised onshore in April 2025 and was not on the grid, so it was not operating in 2024; set to under construction until a full-connection report is found', 'https://www.cweea.com.cn/xwdt/html/40264.html', st=1, year=0)
note_zh: 中國風能協會 2025-04-09：玉環 2 號「陸上工頻系統倒送電一次成功，標誌著項目向併網發電邁出關鍵一步」，即 2025 年 4 月還沒有機組併網；紀錄卻寫 2024 年營運中、504 MW。之後是否全容量併網查不到（實際規模 508 MW：19 部 16 MW 低頻＋6 部 16 MW＋6 部 18 MW，見 cn_vn_step5e）。注意這筆是由舊規則從精選「Huadian Yuhuan 2」改名來的（farm_cleanup.py 約 523 行），新規則要用改名前的名稱「Huadian Yuhuan 2」。
note_en: CWEEA, 9 Apr 2025: Yuhuan 2’s “onshore power-frequency system was back-energised successfully, a key step towards grid connection”, so no unit was on the grid in April 2025, yet the record says operating since 2024 (504 MW). No later full-connection report found (as planned: 508 MW, 19 × 16 MW low-frequency + 6 × 16 MW + 6 × 18 MW). The record was renamed from the curated “Huadian Yuhuan 2” by an older rule (farm_cleanup.py ~line 523), so a new rule must use that pre-rename name.
why: No grid-connection report found after April 2025; imarine/bjx unreachable.

note_zh: 廣西日報（新華網轉，2025-02-08）：「近日，廣西投資集團防城港海上風電示範項目 A 場址全容量並網發電」，開工 545 天全容量並網；國資委：83 台 8.5 MW、70 萬千瓦，2024 年 1 月首批並網。年份改 2025（營運中容量不變，只是時間軸往後一年）。
note_en: Guangxi Daily (via Xinhua, 8 Feb 2025): “recently, site A of Guangxi Investment Group’s Fangchenggang offshore wind demonstration project reached full grid connection”, 545 days after the start; SASAC: 83 × 8.5 MW, 700 MW, first units connected in Jan 2024. Year to 2025 (operating total unchanged; one year later on the timeline).
